summary: Reserve notice source, snapshot and control namespaces and reviewed registration hashes before enabling notice facts.

replay.detail: Projection version 2 rebuilds custom registration and source caches once on ordinary upgrade, rejecting pre-reservation substitute manifests even on quiet databases. Authoritative claims and documents remain intact; downgrade recovery may require replay.

schema.detail: Adds three compiled v1 custom storage manifests with exact serialized-byte SHA256 pins.

rules.detail: Reserved prefixes, prefix ancestors and notice claim kinds cannot be registered with substitute manifests. Reserved fact writes remain unavailable in this slice.

compatibility.detail: Generic custom, claim, history, event, status and replication-diagnostic readers isolate reserved subjects or claim kinds before disclosure. Current, historical, harness-only and typed collection status selectors exclude contaminated subjects before reducing actual fields or claim identities. Claim/history pages fill from visible rows. Custom basis and keyed client history/status refuse reserved resources. Legacy reserved rows cannot poison unrelated direct or cached attention. Full-state backup, rename-proof export and member replication retain complete authoritative bytes for restore/proof integrity. Paired clients are refused these transfer routes on every platform; ancestry-bound agents are refused on Linux only. Non-Linux ancestry binding is absent and agent transfer containment there is not established. This does not provide native recipient-authorized notice reads.

manual.detail: No notice publication is enabled by this change.

recovery.detail: Restore the reviewed manifest, not a substitute registration. Replicated admission ordering and revocation provenance remain a separate change.
